components.note: 女 (woman) — marks women and family terms, as in 妈 mom, 姐 sister, 好 good; 嫁 is a woman marrying out of her family.
家 (jiā) — close sound: 嫁 jià. 家 also means home, which suits a bride going to her new home.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 唔 is a mouth sound, often a hum or Cantonese 'not'.
吾 (wú) — same sound: 唔 wú. 吾 also sounds out 悟 wù and 梧 wú.
爪 (claw, hand) — marks grasping hands and claws, as in 抓 grab; 爬 is crawling and climbing using the hands.
巴 (bā) — loose sound hint (pá vs bā); 巴 also sounds out 吧 ba and 把 bǎ.
宀 (roof) — marks houses and shelter, as in 家 home, 室 room, 客 guest; 寄 is sending something to live at a place, then to mail.
奇 (qí) — loose sound hint (jì vs qí); 奇 also sounds out 骑 qí and 椅 yǐ.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 吹 is blowing, and 欠 on the right shows a person with open mouth exhaling.
欠 (yawn) — an open mouth breathing out; same part in 歌 song and 次 time.
尸 (body) — marks the body and its functions, as in 尿 urine, 屁 fart; 屎 is bodily waste, with 米 for what is eaten.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 塞 is plugging a gap with earth, then to block or stuff; also sài, a border pass.
羽 (feather, wing) — marks wings and flying, as in 翅 wing, 翔 soar; 翻 is flipping like wings, then turning over.
番 (fān) — same sound: 翻 fān. 番 also sounds out 蕃 fān and 幡 fān.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 呐 is calling out; a particle of tone.
内 (nèi) — loose sound hint (nà vs nèi); 内 also sounds out 纳 nà and 钠 nà.
走 (walk) — marks walking and going, as in 起 rise, 赶 hurry; 趟 is a trip, as in 去一趟.
尚 (shàng) — loose sound hint (tàng vs shàng); 尚 also sounds out 躺 tǎng and 堂 táng.
能 (néng) — 能 was originally a picture of a bear, which is why it sits in 熊; the 灬 below is fire dots, 熊 is the bear, as in 熊猫 panda.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 擦 is rubbing and wiping.
察 (chá) — loose sound hint (cā vs chá); same part in 察 chá and 嚓 cā.
舟 (boat) — marks boats and ships, as in 船 ship, 航 sail; 艘 is the measure word for ships.
叟 (sǒu) — close sound: 艘 sōu. 叟 also sounds out 搜 sōu and 嫂 sǎo.
火 (fire) — marks fire and heat, as in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp, 烟 smoke; 炒 is stir-frying over fire.
少 (shǎo) — close sound: 炒 chǎo. 少 also sounds out 吵 chǎo and 抄 chāo.
目 (eye) — eye above little 少: 省 is looking carefully, then saving and omitting; it is also a province, as in 省钱 save money.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 塔 is a tower, built from earth or brick.
荅 (dá) — loose sound hint (tǎ vs dá); same part in 答 dá.
石 (stone) — marks stones and minerals, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break, 磨 grind; 磅 is a pound, a heavy weight, as in 磅秤 scale.
旁 (páng) — close sound: 磅 bàng. 旁 also sounds out 膀 bǎng and 傍 bàng.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 咯 is a sentence-final particle.
各 (gè) — close sound: 咯 gē/lo. 各 also sounds out 格 gé and 路 lù.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 佬 is used for a man, as in 老佬 and 大佬 boss.
老 (lǎo) — same sound: 佬 lǎo. 老 means old and mature.
⺮ (bamboo) — books were once bamboo strips, so ⺮ marks writing and chapters, as in 笔 pen, 简 simple; 篇 is an article.
扁 (biǎn) — close sound: 篇 piān. 扁 also sounds out 偏 piān and 遍 biàn.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 哼 is humming or a snort.
亨 (hēng) — same sound: 哼 hēng. 亨 also sounds out 烹 pēng.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and herbs, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 菜 vegetable; 茶 is tea, from a plant; 人 and 木 below show a tree-like tea bush.
门 (gate; traditional 門) — marks doors and gateways, as in 开 open, 关 close, 间 room; 闹 has a market 市 inside a gate: a noisy, lively place, as in 热闹 bustling.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 摸 is touching or groping.
莫 (mò) — close sound: 摸 mō. 莫 also sounds out 墓 mù and 幕 mù.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 揍 is hitting, as in 揍人 beat someone.
奏 (zòu) — same sound: 揍 zòu. 奏 also sounds out 凑 còu.
犭 (animal; 犬 dog) — marks animals, as in 狗 dog, 猫 cat, 猪 pig; 狼 is the wolf.
良 (liáng) — close sound: 狼 láng. 良 also sounds out 粮 liáng and 浪 làng.
户 (door) — a door 户 with feathers 羽: 扇 is a fan, or a door panel that swings, as in 扇子 fan.
石 (stone) — marks stones and minerals, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break, 磨 grind; 砍 is chopping, as with a stone axe.
欠 (qiàn) — loose sound hint (kǎn vs qiàn).
页 (page, head) — originally a head; now a page, as in 页码 page number. As radical it marks the head or face, as in 顶, 领, 额.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 泡 is bubbles, soaking and steeping, as in 泡茶 make tea.
包 (bāo) — close sound: 泡 pāo. 包 also sounds out 炮 pào and 抱 bào.
女 (woman) — marks women and family terms, as in 妈 mom, 姐 sister, 好 good; 娶 is a man taking a wife.
取 (qǔ) — same sound: 娶 qǔ. 取 means take: to take a woman as wife.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 哟 is an interjection.
约 (yuē) — loose sound hint (yō vs yuē).
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 栋 is the main beam of a house, now a measure word for buildings.
东 (dōng) — close sound: 栋 dòng. 东 also sounds out 冻 dòng and 动 dòng.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 桥 is a bridge, once of wood.
乔 (qiáo) — same sound: 桥 qiáo. 乔 also sounds out 轿 jiào and 骄 jiāo.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 抬 is lifting or carrying.
台 (tái) — same sound: 抬 tái. 台 also sounds out 胎 tāi and 苔 tái.
刂 (knife; 刀) — marks cutting, as in 别 separate, 刻 carve, 划 slice; 剑 is a sword, a blade.
佥 (qiān) — loose sound hint (jiàn); same part in 检 jiǎn, 险 xiǎn and 验 yàn.
巾 (cloth) — marks cloth and hangings, as in 布 cloth, 帽 hat; 幅 is the width of cloth and a measure word for pictures.
畐 (fú) — same sound: 幅 fú. 畐 also sounds out 福 fú and 副 fù.
足 (foot) — marks feet and walking, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump, 路 road; 踩 is stepping on something.
采 (cǎi) — same sound: 踩 cǎi. 采 also sounds out 彩 cǎi and 菜 cài.
虫 (insect) — marks insects and small creatures, as in 蚊 mosquito, 蜜 honey, 蛇 snake; 蛇 is the snake.
它 (tā) — loose sound hint (shé vs tā); 它 was once a picture of a snake.
目 (eye) — marks the eyes and seeing, as in 看 look, 睛 eye, 盯 stare; 瞎 is blind, with 害 adding harm.
害 (hài) — loose sound hint (xiā vs hài); same part in 割 gē and 辖 xiá.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 扣 is buttoning or pulling tight.
口 (kǒu) — close sound: 扣 kòu. 口 here is both mouth and the sound clue.
日 (sun) — marks sun, daylight and time, as in 明 bright, 晚 evening, 早 early; 晕 is a halo around the sun, then dizzy.
军 (jūn) — loose sound hint (yūn vs jūn); same part in 运 yùn.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 填 is filling a hole with earth.
真 (zhēn) — loose sound hint (tián vs zhēn); same part in 镇 zhèn and 慎 shèn.
纟 (silk thread; traditional 糸) — marks thread and cloth, as in 红 red, 给 give, 线 line; 绕 is winding thread around, then going around.
尧 (yáo) — loose sound hint (rào vs yáo); same part in 晓 xiǎo and 烧 shāo.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 溜 is sliding and slipping, as water does.
留 (liú) — close sound: 溜 liū. 留 also sounds out 榴 liú.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 湿 is wet or damp.
显 (xiǎn) — loose sound hint (shī vs xiǎn).
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 撑 is propping up or holding open.
掌 (zhǎng) — close sound: 撑 chēng. 掌 also sounds out 堂 táng and 常 cháng.
